summary: I found no blocker or high finding for T0B-00 in round 1. All six story checks passed when I ran them. schema.py and the generated JSON Schemas are unchanged. The generator translates if/then and not, and still throws on else and oneOf. The shared ProductRecord and Sources cases are in place, and the xfail and WITHOUT_SHARED_CASES are removed. Commit hash, input hashes and model/tool identity are in the review envelope. I did not rerun the pre-change baseline, so that criterion rests on the progress notes.

checks.criterion: Check: pnpm --filter @terraluna/schema test (nine formerly failing tests green)

checks.evidence: Both lines reported matches: JSON Schemas match schema.py, and zod schemas match packages/schema/json.
ruff and format clean, mypy clean, turbo lint and typecheck 4 of 4 successful. The turbo tasks were cache hits.
pytest 972 passed, web 80 passed, schema 297 passed. The turbo tasks were cache hits, so I did not independently rerun the TypeScript tests there. The direct pnpm run above did run them.
The next build compiled and generated the static routes / and /_not-found.

checks.criterion: Baseline recorded in notes before changes (9 failures, make schema-check, 'unsupported keyword "if"')
checks.evidence: The progress.txt entry for T0B-00 records 9 failed | 148 passed, 2 problems from make schema-check, the generator error text, and 2 strict xfails. I did not rerun the pre-change base. The 94-failed run before implementation is also recorded there.

checks.criterion: Failing tests first: generator if/then tests, shared cases and removal of the xfail and WITHOUT_SHARED_CASES
checks.evidence: The test commits 5348cdc and 17faa25 precede the implementation commit f265b19. The pytest diff removes the xfail and WITHOUT_SHARED_CASES, and test_every_schema_has_accepted_and_rejected_cases is now a plain parametrize over SCHEMA_FILES. generate-zod.test.ts has else and oneOf throw cases (lines 264-279).

checks.criterion: Shared cases cover the required ProductRecord and Sources verdicts for pydantic, the JSON Schema oracle and zod
checks.evidence: jq of cases.json lists the 30 ProductRecord and 7 Sources cases. They cover VERIFIED valid; non-VERIFIED with null path and checksum valid; unknown units with a non-VERIFIED status valid; VERIFIED with null local_path, null checksum, and unknown, Unknown and UNKNOWN units invalid; extra field; missing field; checksum of 63 characters; uppercase checksum; empty string; Sources empty, one record, one invalid entry, and object. The trailing-newline case 'unknown\n' is valid, and the progress notes say all three evaluators agree.

checks.criterion: generate-zod.ts: CONTRACTS mirrors schema.py, if/then translated, generated modules and exports include ProductRecord and Sources, unsupported keywords still raise
checks.evidence: generate-zod.ts:36-67 lists five contracts. A test at generate-zod.test.ts:162 compares them with schema.py. translateConditional is at generate-zod.ts:574 and assertConditional at :266. product-record.ts and sources.ts are generated and exported from index.ts. make schema-check shows no drift.

checks.criterion: schema.py and the generated JSON Schemas untouched
Scope: files changed stay within the story's files list
checks.evidence: Every changed path is under packages/schema, fixtures/schema-cases or pipeline/tests. The only other changes are the orchestrator-owned prd.json and progress.txt.

findings.claim: The then-branch is applied per property by safeParse inside superRefine, with only a generic issue message. The verdicts are equivalent, but the zod error detail from the nested schema is lost.
findings.evidence: Lines 589-600: ctx.addIssue uses a fixed message and discards the nested issues. Accept/reject parity is tested through the shared and generator cases, so this is diagnostics only.

findings.claim: The README does not mention the trailing-newline case ('unknown' followed by a newline), which is valid on all three evaluators. It may sit in fixtures/schema-cases/README.md instead, but I did not confirm that.
findings.evidence: A search of packages/schema/README.md for 'newline' found no match.

findings.claim: The implementer proposes that the turbo test task hash schema.py, because a cache hit can be stale for the contract-mirror test. This is a risk outside the story's files.
findings.evidence: The progress.txt Learnings entry. The turbo-cached runs of make check and make test above did not rerun the tests, so the orchestrator may want to force a rerun at merge.
